>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Electricity" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=586" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Sonic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=697" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 103

**Price** 2,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Fighting Fan](/Weapons.aspx?ID=284)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This iridescent, black _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [shock](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2847) [thundering](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2850) [fighting fan](/Weapons.aspx?ID=284)_ is crafted from the crackling feathers of [thunderbirds](/Monsters.aspx?ID=825) to resemble one of the beast’s mighty wings. Channeling the avian’s tempestuous nature, you are surrounded by a stormy shell of wind and electricity while wielding a storm herald, granting you resistance 5 to electricity and sonic damage.

**Activate—Call the Storm** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You channel the full might of a storm with you as its epicenter. All creatures within 30 feet take 3d10 electricity damage and 3d10 sonic damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include feathers from a [thunderbird](/Monsters.aspx?ID=825).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
